comment: Autologous gene therapy with variable concentration (2-10 x 10^6 cells/ml); EU brand Libmeldy, US brand Lenmeldy. RxNorm only has fixed concentration (11.8e6 cells/ml) for Lenmeldy (US brand); no volume-specific concept for Libmeldy exists
suggestion: No better concept available — unbranded clinical drug injection is the best standard match
